searchQueries.title: Search keywords
searchQueries.description: One Amazon search per keyword, e.g. standing desk, wireless earbuds, protein powder.

startUrls.title: Amazon URLs
startUrls.description: Search result pages (amazon.com/s?k=… with any filters), Best Sellers, New Releases, Movers & Shakers or Most Wished For pages (any category), or product pages (/dp/ASIN).

asins.title: ASINs
asins.description: Product ASINs, e.g. B0B41YH9B6. Each is read from its product page (charged as Product with details).

marketplace.title: Marketplace
marketplace.description: Amazon store to read: searches, ASINs and pasted search URLs all use it. Best Sellers and other list URLs are read from the store in the URL.

includeDetails.title: Full product page
includeDetails.description: Open each product page for brand, bullet points, specs and details table, Best Sellers Rank, categories, availability, seller and ships-from, all images, variations and description. Charged as Product with details instead of Product.

maxItemsPerSearch.title: Max products per search or list
maxItemsPerSearch.description: Stop each search or list after this many products. Amazon shows about 7 pages per search; past 300, searches are split by price range automatically. Lists hold up to 100.
